cases.input: A run uses a 2024 regional grid factor and AR6 GWP100.
cases.expect: It pins the factor version and separate characterization-set version.

cases.input: The publisher replaces a factor after methodology correction.
cases.expect: A successor version preserves historical citations.

cases.input: A technology-specific factor is unavailable and a regional proxy is used.
cases.expect: The run records proxy substitution and representativeness downgrade.

cases.input: A factor lacks denominator quantity kind and unit.
cases.expect: The factor is rejected as dimensionally unusable.

cases.input: A CO2e factor hides the GWP characterization release.
cases.expect: The result is rejected because characterization must be separately pinned.

cases.input: A corrected factor overwrites the cited 2023 version.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; successor lineage is required.

cases.input: Cloud spend is labelled measured emissions without an EEIO method.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected; spend is only an explicit proxy with uncertainty.
